svg.title: How Localize names the screen: the live screen is turned into a fingerprint, compared with every saved screen, look-alikes are told apart by the highlight and the title, a screen it cannot name gets a not sure answer, and black screen and no signal are named on any device
svg.text: Where am I? It looks at the live screen and names it,
the way you know a face. When it is not sure, it says so.
The live fingerprint is compared with every saved screen
The screen is shrunk to a tiny grid.
Each square notes if it is lighter or
darker than its neighbour. Small details
Like a face: new hair, same face.
SAVED SCREENS OF THE NAVIGATION TREE
3 saved screens are close: same layout, new posters. Which one is it?
Same layout: the underline under the menu tab decides
On the live screen the highlight is under Movies.
Same squares: the title in the top-left corner decides
No saved screen is close enough: it never guesses
a screen not saved in the tree
A saved screen must be within 14. The closest is 34.
It says so and shows these screens; it never picks one.
no answer is better than a wrong one
Named on any device, from the picture alone
on every device: a TV box,
A test knows where it is before it presses a key
Lost, with no known position? A goto asks Localize first,
then finds the way from the screen it names.
